rows.claim: Thermodynamic computing inverts the noise contract: noise stops being corruption to shield against and becomes the mechanism that generates the desired output distribution, moving the success metrics to distributional fidelity, mixing time, and energy per independent sample.
rows.quote: noise = the mechanism that generates the desired distribution
rows.steal: Pick one estate surface that treats ambient churn as corruption to suppress (transient pytest collection errors, untracked-draft wiggle flagged by the census patrol) and bank one row where that churn is instead read as a sampling signal about tree state: one sitting, landing spot the next census_drift_patrol receipt or memory/attention.md patrol line.
rows.falsifier: A system claimed as noise-as-resource whose output is unchanged when the noise source is fully suppressed would kill the noise-is-the-mechanism reading; symmetrically, an estate churn signal whose suppression never changes any downstream verdict would kill the churn-as-signal steal.

rows.claim: A physical substrate counts as a computer only through engineered correspondence (input encoding, controlled state space, reproducible transition law, measurable output, task mapping, error model, reset/train loop); bare physics-computes is the Putnam pancomputationalism trap.
rows.quote: The phrase I would use is not “natural computation,” but “engineered exploitation of natural dynamics.”
rows.steal: Audit one estate holding surface for its correspondence spec in one sitting: the verkle/INDEX tip has no cross-node readout contract (the mesh keystone gap: tip_witness exists, never published), so draft the missing readout row (encoding + error model + consumer) for one tip artifact and register it under watch/inbox/ mesh foundations follow-up.
rows.falsifier: A deployed substrate (physical chip, estate index, or lane) with no defined input encoding or error model that still passes its task gate repeatably across independent operators would falsify the correspondence-necessity claim.

rows.claim: Big-N machine claims must be audited for spatial vs temporal multiplexing: the famous 100,000-spin coherent Ising machine was ~120,000 optical pulses time-sharing one 5-km fiber cavity with a digital fast-matrix-multiplier circuit inside the feedback loop, not 100,000 simultaneous physical oscillators.
rows.quote: The 100,000 spins are time-division-multiplexed, not simultaneously instantiated in separate physical hardware.
rows.steal: Label every estate denominator with its multiplexing kind in one sitting: the standing tests census is a collected count taken by --collect-only (temporal, one tree at one moment), never an executed-in-parallel count, so add one spatial-vs-temporal line to the next census receipt and to the next width-envelope claim (50-wide means 50 children over a window, not 50 simultaneous turns).
rows.falsifier: An audited headline N that turns out to be genuinely spatially instantiated (N independent physical elements, or N truly simultaneous executions) where the audit assumed temporal reuse would falsify the pattern's universality; the reverse misread on a load-bearing estate count would falsify its necessity.

rows.claim: Vendor magnitudes must be tiered by measurement level before reuse: Extropic's ~10,000x energy figure is a simulation/system-level claim (arXiv:2510.23972, verified live this ask: abstract claims parity with GPUs using approximately 10,000 times less energy on a simple image benchmark), not a wall-plug silicon measurement, and the $75M CHIPS letter of intent is a funding signal, not technical validation.
rows.quote: This is a simulation-level claim, not a deployed hardware measurement.
rows.steal: Before reusing any vendor, commit-message, or receipt magnitude, name its instrument tier (measured / simulated / projected / hand-copied) or strike it: one sitting, applied to the next receipt that carries a headline number, landing spot watch/inbox/ (the same surgery citation_lint's PHANTOM-NUMBER gate forces on prose).
rows.falsifier: A load-bearing estate decision built on an untiered magnitude that later measurement vindicates exactly would show tiering is overhead, not necessity; a tiered-and-measured vendor headline would show the discipline is sometimes already met upstream.

rows.claim: Cohort synthesis banks value by carrying unresolved disagreements as annotated forks with IDs and status (F-01 through F-07, Open/Converging/Closed) in a living document instead of resolving them by majority vote or silent averaging.
rows.quote: Disagreements should be carried forward as annotated forks in the living document, not resolved by majority vote.
rows.steal: Give the estate's open rulings fork IDs and status rows in the next synthesis round (naming: PROVISIONAL pending law bytes; routing table: dead offpeak-idle plan vs the 09-26 max-concurrency envelope): one sitting, landing spot the next ouroboros or PRIME_JUDGMENT lane file under watch/inbox/gala_20260925/ouroboros/.
rows.falsifier: A fork register that only grows (no fork ever reaching Closed on evidence) or whose closed forks were closed by seniority or vote count rather than a named observation would show the protocol decays into stale flags and kill the law as stated.
